import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2; // 4952

        static class Edge {
            int v, r;
            long f, c, p;
            Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
                this.v = v;
                this.r = r;
                this.f = f;
                this.c = c;
                this.p = p;
            }
        }

        static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        static int[] sz;
        static long mc;

        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            sz = new int[n];
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static boolean[] vis;
        static int[] par;
        static long[] pot, dist;

        static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            vis = new boolean[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INFLL);
            dist[s] = 0;
            if (sparse) {
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] cur = pq.poll();
                    int u = (int) cur[1];
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c) {
                            long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                                dist[e.v] = nd;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                                pq.offer(new long[]{-nd, e.v});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c) {
                            long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                                dist[e.v] = nd;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = INFLL;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= INFLL) return 0;
            long df = INFLL;
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v].get(r.r).c - adj[r.v].get(r.r).f);
                u = r.v;
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
                e.f += df;
                r.f -= df;
                price[0] += df * e.p;
                u = r.v;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INFLL, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            pot = new long[n];
            long flow = 0;
            price[0] = 0;
            while (true) {
                long df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse);
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;
        int totalNodes = sink + 1;
        Flow.init(totalNodes);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INFLL, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INFLL, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                long cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, totalNodes, true);
        // assert flow == k;
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
